scope.notation: G is the retained device; W/Q/B are BE32/BE64/byte loads; U is modulo2^32. Object offsets and masks are hexadecimal; byte counts, strides and frames are decimal. Mv is the selected VS metadata, Rv=VS+0x1A0*v, Ccode=W(VS+0x20). encode(a)=(a&0x1FFFFFFF)+((((a>>20)&0xFFF)+0x200)&0x1000).

Each leaf's list processes its current item before testing sentinel1000, so the terminal item writes and duplicate destinations retain order.

pressureProgressBoundary.question: When does the selected AC610 pressure-copy loop make finite progress after a flush?
pressureProgressBoundary.notation: U32 is modulo2^32; S32 is its signed interpretation; W is a BE32 load. G is device, c is cursor, E=W(G+0x34), p is source-minus4, H is header, R is remaining words and d is group divisor. Offsets are hexadecimal; counts are decimal.
pressureProgressBoundary.capacity: 0x826AC630..0x826AC658 computes A=(S32(U32(E-c))>>2)-1, then signed q=trunc0(A/d). Native zero-divisor and division-overflow guards remain. q<=0 skips the chunk; positive q selects k=minU32(U32(q*d),R). Group rounding precedes this minimum, so the final k need not be a multiple of d.
pressureProgressBoundary.chunk: 0x826AC66C..0x826AC69C decreases remaining by k, emits one BE32 header with the low16(k-1) count shifted 16 and ORed with H, then performs k ordered preincrement source loads and destination stores. It advances p by 4*k, c by 4*(k+1), and H by k, modulo the native widths. No separate 65536-word chunk limit is present; these transfers alone do not establish packet validity.
pressureProgressBoundary.retryAndExit: For nonzero remaining, 0x826AC6A8 publishes c to G+0x30, 0x826AC6B0 calls C588 and 0x826AC6B4 reloads G+0x30 into r4 before retrying. The helper does not directly consume C588's r3. Completion returns actual full64 r4 at 0x826AC6BC without a final G+0x30 store. With entry R=0, a positive q still emits a zero-payload count header before returning; an empty call is not universally a no-op.
sufficientConditions: Initially 1<=R0<=4294967295, full64 r7=Z32(R0), r8=Z32(d), r4=Z32(c), r6=Z32(p), with selected d in{1,4,6,16}. Every loop entry has aligned c/E and ordinary-integer 0<=E-c<=2147483647; all device, source and emitted command extents are valid and nonwrapping.

The original requested source words survive until their ordered loads. Command, frame and selected helper writes preserve unread source, device fields and retained G/H/p/R/d except their explicit effects; physical aliases and saved restoration bytes are included.

Save/restore interfaces and every reached C588 finish normally and finitely, preserve required full64 retained registers, frames and readable/writable extents, and retain the selected caller-live ABI. Their accepted ordered effects still occur.

At every reached C588 return, the reloaded c=W(G+0x30) and E=W(G+0x34) satisfy 4*(d+1)<=E-c<=2147483647, with the alignment, extent and retention predicates still true at the next loop entry. A returned cursor alone does not establish this predicate.
pressureProgressBoundary.termination: Under these sufficient conditions, positive chunks decrease the natural-number rank ceil(R/d), with k>=d unless completing the remainder. At most ceil(R0/d) productive chunks and at most ceil(R0/d) flushes occur, including a possible initial no-space flush. Exactly R0 payload transfers occur. No wall-time or unconditional helper-return bound follows.
pressureProgressBoundary.counterexample: Supply d=16,R=16,c=0x1000,E=0x1040: 64 bytes give A=15,q=0, below the 68-byte productive minimum. If each finite C588 return restores the same G+0x30/G+0x34 and protected state, cursor/source/header/remaining do not change and the retry can repeat indefinitely. This is a supplied conditional state, not an observed natural hang.

pressureProgressBoundary.remainingDiscriminator: For a selected root/context/generation, check the actual C588 return's capacity and protected-state predicate. Do not select an allocator, callback or arbitrary-copy descendant from this counterexample alone.
pressureProgressBoundary.falsificationCondition: Different supported native words, a divisor or count outside the stated domain, signed/wrap mismatch, unreadable or overlapping protected extents, changed retained state, nonreturning helper or failed post-flush predicate invalidates the sufficient contract. Failure of a sufficient condition alone does not prove a hang.

replacementObligations: An allocator-free replay is conditional on an exact selected row with all effects modeled. Compatible hit/no-pressure is smaller than arbitrary miss/copy coverage, but still has cache copies and possible metadata/packet/stamp work. C7A8 fast fit reuses command storage; it does not remove the need to preserve that owned guest extent or later B818 outcomes.

Refuse before mutation for unmodeled branch/copy/cache/import/ABI, unreadable or unbounded metadata/sentinel/patch ranges, command pressure/rollover/wait/dynamic target, missing persistent history or ID/stamp coherence, or unproved later take/commit/retention. These are missing-proof classes, not permanent bans on every nonempty metadata/inline/ID row.

A natural-row observer needs root/caller/commit/G/thread/epoch/resource-generation identity; all dirty words and effective stride; each helper's order/full64 return; primary/second variant and hit/busy/miss/inline/linkage result; complete selected metadata/patch lists; code length/source/destination/copy/cache arguments; before/after ID/key/stamp/cursor/limits; and every ordered geometry take's manager, mutable bytes, progress predicate and result. Aggregate reservation or memo/filtered allocator counters cannot select this row.

Retain immutable geometry at the matched commit and join first safe guest reuse to real host retirement. Do not speculatively run ADD88 and then whole Original: already performed effects would repeat. Preserve per-generation C*(t), overlap order, retained Originals and future cache/code coherence separately from current host draw identity.
guards: General-length827F8550 and A72F8 source-range effects remain exact selected-path queries; guarded count12 bytes do not prove arbitrary copy, full ABI or final cache visibility.

Physical/frame/code aliases can join otherwise distinct persistent/inline destinations. Local byte models do not prove all-reader omission, successful natural allocation or full architectural replacement.
This bounded static contract admits no additional consume and makes no runtime frequency or natural-row claim.
conclusion: Selected linkage leaves have finite conditional byte models, and ADA38's reservation/source-copy/cache/linkage/patch/publication order is explicit. Natural row selection, general copy/cache and reached pressure/target/ABI/lifetime contracts remain the boundary to exact dirty-UP replay.
